common.tagline: Compliant Cameroonian payroll in 10 minutes a month

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this action.

auth.name: Full name
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A phrase of several words works best.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
auth.passwordCompromised: This password appears in a known data breach. Please choose another one.
auth.emailTaken: This account cannot be created with this email address.
auth.locked: Too many failed sign-ins for this account: try again in a few minutes.

twoFactor.verifyHelp: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
twoFactor.setupWhy: It is mandatory for owners and payroll managers: a password alone is not enough to protect payroll data.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a similar app, then enter the code it shows.
twoFactor.backupCodesHelp: Keep them offline. Each one allows a single sign-in if you lose your phone.

company.title: Your company
company.help: This information appears on your payslips and filings.
company.workAccidentRate: Work accident rate (notified by the CNPS)
company.niuTaken: This NIU is already registered on PaieCam. Ask the account owner for an invitation.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.comingSoon: Employees and payroll arrive in the next phases.

settings.readOnly: Only the owner can change this information.

errors.already_member: This person is already on the team.
errors.self: You cannot change your own access.
errors.owner: An owner's role cannot be changed here.
errors.rate_limited: Too many invitations sent: try again in an hour.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.signInFirst: Sign in, or create an account with the email address that received the invitation.

errors.accepted: This invitation has already been used.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address than your account's.
errors.already_member: You are already a member of this company.

employees.title: Employees

fields.cnpsKeep: Leave blank to keep the current number
fields.password: Your password (required to change these details)

employees.revealHelp: Every display is recorded in the audit log.
employees.archiveHelp: The employee leaves the list; their record and history are kept.

errors.archived: This employee has left: the record can no longer be changed.
errors.end_before_hire: The departure date is before the hire date.
errors.employees_tenant_matricule_key: This employee ID is already in use.
errors.employees_tenant_cnps_key: This CNPS number is already assigned to another employee.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many password attempts: try again in a few minutes.

dataRights.title: Employee's right of access
dataRights.help: Export of all data held about this employee, to be sent to them on request (Law No. 2024/017). Every export is recorded in the audit log.

import.title: Import employees
import.step2: Fill in one row per employee (500 at most). Bank details are entered afterwards on each record.
import.step3: Upload the file: it is fully checked before anything is imported.
import.fixAndRetry: Fix the file and check it again. Nothing is imported while any row has an error.

reasons.duplicate_matricule: Employee ID appears twice in the file.
reasons.duplicate_cnps: CNPS number appears twice in the file.
reasons.existing_cnps: This CNPS number is already assigned.

fileErrors.too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
fileErrors.not_xlsx: This file is not a valid Excel .xlsx workbook.
fileErrors.too_many_entries: This file is too complex to import.
fileErrors.uncompressed_too_large: This file is too large once opened.
fileErrors.too_many_rows: The file has more than 500 employees: split it.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.provisionalBanner: PROVISIONAL — the 2026 payroll rules have not yet been validated by the chartered accountant. These payslips are for checking only and cannot be validated.
payroll.variablesHelp: Amounts in FCFA, overtime in hours (e.g. 8.5), absences in unpaid days. Leave blank for zero.
payroll.reopened: Entry reopened: the calculated payslips were deleted.
payroll.validateHelp: Validation freezes the payslips: any correction will be made through an adjustment the following month.
payroll.validatedMsg: Payroll validated. The PDF payslips are being generated.
payroll.frozen: Payroll validated on {date}: the payslips are frozen.

errors.period_not_open: Entry is closed for this month.
errors.period_frozen: This month is validated: it can no longer be recalculated.
errors.draft_rules: The payroll rules are not validated: final calculation is impossible.
errors.provisional_payslips: Some payslips are provisional: payroll cannot be validated until the rules are.
errors.employee_not_in_period: This employee is not under contract this month.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many password attempts: try again in a few minutes.

verify.title: Payslip verification
verify.authentic: Authentic payslip: issued and signed by PaieCam.
verify.invalidSignature: Invalid signature: this document cannot be trusted.
verify.compare: Compare with your PDF file (it stays on your device)
verify.same: The file is identical to the original.
verify.different: The file has been modified: it does not match the original.
verify.privacy: This page shows no information about the employee or the amounts.

declarations.title: Filings
declarations.none: No filings generated for this month.
declarations.dipeWarning: DIPE: provisional format, to be validated by the chartered accountant before any filing.
declarations.lockHelp: All filings are submitted: you can lock the month. It can no longer be changed.

errors.already_filed: A filing has already been submitted: regeneration is impossible.
errors.not_filed: Mark the filing as submitted first.
errors.date_in_future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.declarations_not_filed: All filings must be submitted before locking.
